title: A Spectral Framework for Universal Proxy Regularization in Model Merging
abstract: arXiv:2611.17728v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Model merging constructs multi-task models without expensive joint training but often suffers from parameter interference. Some solutions mitigate this by constraining finetuning using data from the other tasks to be merged, violating the core independence and privacy assumption of model merging. Recent work offers preliminary empirical evidence that a universal, task-agnostic proxy distribution can substitute for such data, but leaves open when and why it suffices. To this end, we propose a \textit{Spectral Framework for Universal Proxy Regularization}, which characterizes the relationship between a proxy distribution and the distribution of other tasks to be merged through spectral coverage ($\alpha$) and leakage ($\beta$). Based on the framework, we derive a unified parameter interference bound: smaller $(\alpha, \beta)$ provably yields lower parameter interference through better spectral alignment. translated_title: 模型合并中通用代理正则化的谱框架
translated_abstract: 模型合并无需昂贵的联合训练即可构建多任务模型，但常常受到参数干扰的困扰。一些解决方案通过使用待合并的其他任务的数据来约束微调，从而缓解这一问题，但这违背了模型合并的核心独立性和隐私假设。近期的工作提供了初步的实证证据，表明一个通用的、与任务无关的代理分布可以替代此类数据，但其何时以及为何有效尚不清楚。为此，我们提出了通用代理正则化的谱框架，该框架通过谱覆盖率（α）和谱泄漏（β）来刻画代理分布与待合并其他任务分布之间的关系。基于该框架，我们推导出一个统一的参数干扰上界：更小的（α, β）可通过更好的谱对齐在理论上保证更低的参数干扰。为了利用这样的代理，我们增强了……
tldr: 本文提出通用代理正则化的谱框架，通过谱覆盖率与谱泄漏两个指标刻画代理分布与任务分布的关系，并从理论上证明更小的谱指标可通过更好的谱对齐降低模型合并中的参数干扰。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a spectral framework for universal proxy regularization that characterizes the relationship between proxy and task distributions via spectral coverage and leakage, and provably shows that smaller spectral metrics yield lower parameter interference in model merging through better spectral alignment.
